ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 2.5:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/grey pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity black field originating at the peduncle connection and extending bilaterally into the medial sections of both lobes; remainder of lobes composed of high-intensity white pixels containing scattered dark linear and punctate geometric marks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 48 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with prominent jagged peaks; left lobe (viewer's left) exhibits broader, more irregular serrations, while the right lobe displays a higher frequency of smaller, sharper peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex leading edges tapering to distal tips; trailing edge follows a sigmoidal curve with concavity increasing near the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dark punctate clusters visible on the distal tip of the left lobe and scattered along the leading margins of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of dark, unaligned linear marks (rake marks) visible on both lobes; a prominent set of 3-4 near-parallel lines is located on the mid-ventral surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe linear scarring (rake marks) distributed across both lobes; the left distal tip shows significant irregular pigmentation and potential minor amputation/trauma at the trailing margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique combination of high-density rake marks localized within the white fields of the fluke, particularly the distinct parallel group on the right lobe.
